supports: More tax relief for Nassau County families and seniors
positions.quote: She will continue fighting to lower the tax burden by restoring the full State and Local Tax (SALT) Deduction and providing additional relief for Nassau County families and seniors.

source.title: Jeanine C. Driscoll for Congress (campaign site)

positions.impact: A full SALT deduction would mainly lower federal taxes for homeowners in high-tax areas like Nassau. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Keeping the southern border closed to unauthorized crossings
positions.quote: In Congress, Jeanine will stand up for Nassau taxpayers, support law enforcement and ensure the southern border can never be opened again.

source.title: Jeanine C. Driscoll for Congress (campaign site)

positions.impact: She would vote for border enforcement measures. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
